title: Nudura Installation Manual (fr.nudura.com copy of the manufacturer's installation manual)
jurisdiction: Manufacturer installation manual (North American residential guidance; approval claims as stated inside, not verified); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
code_edition: No single edition stated. §2.3 (p45) cites 2003, 2006 and 2009 international residential codes; §2.4 (p46) cross-references ICC-ES ESR-2092 (2024-2012 editions)
document_date: No revision date located in the extracted text; unknown if unstated

facts.text: Disclaimer: the information is a 'Guide Only' and 'SHALL NOT be used as a substitute for professional engineering consultation' where a design strays outside prescriptive scope.

§2.3 lists documents to give the building official: the installation manual and 'the applicable Nudura evaluation report or Intertek Product Certification Documentation for your region' (USA: ICC-ES ESR-2092; CAN: Intertek to CAN/ULC S717.1; Europe: EOTA ETA-07/0034).

§2.3 says 'Since 2005, prescriptive structural design tables ... have also been provided under ... Part 9 of the Ontario, Quebec, Alberta and British Columbia Building Codes.' This is the manufacturer's statement and is not verified here.
The USA paragraph in §2.3 refers to 'the 2003, 2006 and 2009 international residential Building Codes', which does not match the 2024-2012 editions of ESR-2092.

§2.4 lists manufacturer-claimed approvals: ICC-ES (AC-353) ESR-2092; State of Florida FL1585-R3; Miami-Dade NOA 16-0627-01; City of New York; CAN/ULC S717.1 via Intertek SDID 21903; EOTA ETA-07/0034. None of these source documents is attached.
§2.5 lists typical building-department documents: working drawings showing ICF use and reinforcing steel size and spacing, elevations and sections, and floor and roof connection details.

limitations: Non-Alberta comparative attachment; this is a manufacturer or industry guide, not a code or an evaluation report.
